name: Juma

queries.query: Juma Uzbekistan cadastral map official cadastre registry parcel
queries.result: Discovery identified the official National Geoinformation Portal of Uzbekistan at open.ngis.uz, operated by the Cadastre Agency, and official Digital Government documentation describing open real-estate-register information. No Juma-specific public parcel response or geometry was obtained.

queries.query: Juma O'zbekiston kadastr xaritasi rasmiy yer uchastkasi
queries.result: Qidiruv rasmiy Kadastr agentligi Milliy geoaxborot portalini va uning davlat ko'chmas mulk reyestridagi ochiq ma'lumotlar haqidagi tavsifini ko'rsatdi. Juma bo'yicha anonim kadastr poligoni, xavfsiz native ID, sxema yoki CRS javobi olinmadi.

officialLeads.evidence: Search result identifies the National Geoinformation Portal and attributes it to the Cadastre Agency; the portal advertises cadastral-number and map search. The portal itself timed out during direct anonymous retrieval.
officialLeads.locality: National official source; Juma/Samarqand local coverage not independently verified.

officialLeads.evidence: Official description says open.ngis.uz provides open data from the State Register of Rights to Real Estate and can provide a land plot cadastral number, address, and use purpose. It does not expose a public parcel geometry endpoint in the page content.
officialLeads.locality: National system description, not a Juma local-custodian page.

officialLeads.scope: Reported ArcGIS REST machine endpoint for the national portal
officialLeads.evidence: Discovery located this endpoint as the reported REST service catalog backing open.ngis.uz; direct anonymous TLS connection timed out before any service list, schema, CRS, or layer response was returned.
officialLeads.locality: National service host; Juma coverage not verified.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: timeout from local request runtime after 25 seconds
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Ordinary TLS GET did not complete. No TLS bypass, login, CAPTCHA action, or private token was used.
The reported ArcGIS REST catalog could not be reached anonymously; no schema, CRS, safe ID, or geometry response was obtained.
Read the official description of the National Geoinformation Portal and its open-register scope; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
Read the Uzbek-language equivalent; it confirms the same national open-register and cadastral-number service scope.
An unrelated agriculture GIS host was not used as cadastral evidence; no certificate exception was attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uzbekistan has an official national cadastral/geoinformation portal and documented open real-estate-register services, but Juma-specific anonymous parcel coverage and geometry access were not verified.

blocker: No public anonymous Juma parcel service or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was verified. The national portal and REST-host timeouts do not establish citywide parcel absence.
remainingUncertainty: The portal may expose runtime-only ArcGIS routes, require a reachable bootstrap, or provide geometry only through an authenticated or interactive workflow. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe identity lookup was attempted.
nextStep: Retry the official portal/REST host when reachable, inspect its current public JavaScript/configuration, and validate Juma coverage, schema, CRS, stable native IDs, and a small safe geometry response before considering adapter qualification.
notes: WUP exact point preserved in latitude/longitude order. No GeoJSON sample retained because no qualifying parcel geometry was obtained. Research packet is not source integration or admission.
